source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (D:/Projects/echarts/dist/echarts.js) + zrender 6.1.0, node SSR (svg), controlled clock
note: R6-C: steps of setOption or dispatchAction (the first at T0; a next one after the previous ran out, T + 10000, or `after` ms into it; notMerge unless `merge`), recorded at the last T + samples. Each element: an item path of a new series (id s<series>/<dataIndex>/<path>) or another path of its view (s<series>/x/<k>); morph[i] = __morphT >= 0 and not combining, d[i] the replaced buildPath's PathProxy data (codes M1 L2 C3 Q4 A5 Z6 R7); comb[i] = __isCombineMorphing, pieces = its childrenRef() in order; style = fill (a colour, or a gradient: type, x / y / x2 / y2 or r, global, stops [offset, colour]), stroke, lineWidth, opacity, shadowBlur, shadowOffsetX, shadowOffsetY, shadowColor, fillOpacity, strokeOpacity, lineDashOffset, miterLimit (the prototype's where not own) -- a key the same at every sample written once. hits: at the samples a case names, findHover at the middle of each combining child's box, rounded (where the child contains it): whether the child is the target, the ecData its parents reach. orders: the display list's item paths and children (<id>#<k>) in order. display: every path drawn under a series view (digest, opacity, a child or not). oldGroups / newGroups: getGroupId and the child group per item of every series (the dist's SeriesData). oldRest / newRest: every item path at rest. Every number is the hex of its double.
